items.t: Adventure Cove Waterpark closes for all of 2027
items.d: Closed 1 Jan to 31 Dec 2027 for a major refurbishment. Announced 15 Nov.
items.need: Read it and decide whether guests, the Directory or the next edition need a change.
items.look: Resorts World Sentosa announced on 15 Nov that the waterpark will be temporarily closed from 1 January to 31 December 2027, with a new concept to follow and details later. Season pass holders will be contacted by RWS; ticket holders affected will have options. Guests booking 2027 trips should be told. Not in the Directory, so no entry to change. Suggested for the next edition's news.

items.t: BTS at the National Stadium, 17, 19, 20 and 22 Dec: all sold out
items.d: Four sold-out nights plus month-long fan events islandwide in December.
items.need: Read it and decide whether guests, the Directory or the next edition need a change.
items.look: BTS play the National Stadium on 17, 19, 20 and 22 December at 7pm; all tickets are sold out. Fan events run across the city through December (Jewel, National Gallery, National Museum, Sentosa and more). Expect heavy crowds, hotel demand and ride-hailing surges around those dates; point guests without tickets to the fan events. Jewel Changi Airport is in the Directory; no entry needs changing.
